facts.fact: A Ministry of Health communiqué of 21 July 2026 announced the imminent launch of the national citizen health platform Sahetna.tn, which ministry adviser Inès Ayadi said had entered its final phase of technical configuration and network deployment, giving hospital patients online access to their medical files and care history on a unified shared medical record; it was not yet in service.

La Presse reports on 21 July 2026 that the Ministry of Health's general directorate announced Sahetna.tn and the unified shared medical record as the ministry's own e-health project, with the ministry's roadmap extending the identifier and portal to private clinics and laboratories through joint technical commissions; no supplier or funder is named.
